name: Physarum Agents
description: Physics Lab — 65k slime-mould agents (Jones 2010) sense, turn, move and deposit on the sim ring, weaving a living transport network that feeds on the image's red channel. Click drops a pheromone bloom, hold to lure, bass pulses the deposit. graph · 3 passes · @group(1) sim ring.

params.name: Sense Angle
params.description: Angle between the forward and side sensors (the turn is 1.5× it): narrow makes long straight veins, wide makes a tight mesh

params.name: Sense Distance
params.description: How far ahead each agent smells: sets the network's cell size

params.name: Move Speed
params.description: Agent step per frame — the network re-routes faster

params.name: Trail Persistence
params.description: Deposit / decay balance: low keeps only fresh trails, high lets veins thicken and remember

simRing.packing: xy position (px, torus), z heading (rad), w alive
